# 279. Rapporter, mera rapporter

**Feed**: aktiepodden  
**Published**: 2026-10-30  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The Q3 report-season episode focuses on Nordic engineering, where strong orders at Alfa Laval and Munters contrast with misses at Epiroc and Note, and on Storytel's strong subscriber growth despite Spotify competition. In a pharma sector facing large patent expiries, the hosts favour outperformers such as Sobi, Orion and weekly case Eli Lilly. Sentiment toward industrials is improving, helped by Anthropic's IPO news, but AI worries remain ahead of Alphabet and Microsoft reports.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 STORY-B — Storytel | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Hosts hold Storytel in their portfolios and expect to stay; subscriber growth, ARPU and publishing were strong.

#### Reasoning

Q3 delivered the largest subscriber additions since Q3 2023, higher ARPU and 30-40% publishing growth. A host calls the stock attractive, mainly because owning publishers gives Storytel a lever over Spotify's Nordic title access. Publishing also offsets slower streaming growth. Hosts are nonetheless split, noting Spotify's push and valuation concerns; cited analysts are mostly at hold while raising targets.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Spotify's intensified audiobook offer hurts Nordic subscriber growth
- if publishing growth stalls
- if subscriber growth turns negative as in Q2

> *"Så vi har ju Storytel i våra portföljer och kommer väl sitta kvar med dem känns det som."*

---

### 🟢 ALFA — Alfa Laval | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Organic orders +33%, 14% above consensus; marine and energy demand strong; about 15x next-year EBIT seen as undemanding.

#### Reasoning

A host calls the share very exciting after a strong report with orders well above consensus. Support comes from an ageing, under-invested fleet, higher shipping rates from Middle East disruption, energy orders up about 35% and data-centre tailwinds. Valuation of about 15x next-year EBIT is not seen as stretched. No explicit buy recommendation was given, so this is an inferred positive view.

#### Sell Triggers

- if conversion of orders to sales stays slow
- if marine demand weakens as shipping rates normalise
- if the large-cap industrial rally reverses

> *"Det tycker jag är en jättespännande aktie och jag snabbkikade på värderingen bara. Det är typ 15 gånger rörelseresultatet inför nästa år här."*

---

### 🟠 MTRS — Munters | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Orders far above consensus on data-centre demand, but tariffs and a slow US plant ramp weigh on margins; shares have been weak.

#### Reasoning

A host finds Munters fairly interesting given weak shares versus a strong order book for 2027. Orders rose 17% and beat consensus by 42%, with AirTech apparently turning. The thesis needs margin recovery: tariffs have not been passed on fully and the US factory lacks volume. Management says rising production should help earnings next year.

#### Sell Triggers

- if tariff costs cannot be passed on to customers
- if the US factory fails to reach sufficient volume
- if orders do not convert into earnings in 2027

> *"Så jag tycker den där ändå ser ganska intressant ut, särskilt mot bakgrund av hur svagt aktierna går."*

---

### 🟠 NOTE — Note | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Repeated sales miss versus own guidance, but strong order book, defence acquisitions and warehouse-move timing effects keep the thesis alive.

#### Reasoning

Note missed its own organic growth guidance for a further quarter, which hosts call a sign of weakness and not confidence-inspiring, and shares fell sharply. However, orders have been strong for many quarters, defence acquisitions add structural exposure, and a warehouse move appears to explain slower order conversion. Hosts say hope remains if these are timing effects.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the company misses its guidance again
- if the order book fails to convert into sales after the warehouse move
- if order cancellations rise

> *"Hoppet lever fortfarande för Note."*

---

### 🟢 LLY — Eli Lilly | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Weekly case: GLP-1 market leader with about 55% share, far faster growth and higher margins than peers, PEG 1 vs sector above 2.

#### Reasoning

In a sector short of growth, a host sees Lilly as the top pick among large pharma, with the strongest position. 16% expected growth versus 6% for peers, margin at 45% heading above 50% in 2027, and PEG around 1 against over 2 for peers justify EV/EBIT of 35 vs 16. The host cautions that growth forecasts are unreliable, calls it partly a FOMO case and warns against expecting a repeat of the past decade.

#### Sell Triggers

- if GLP-1 price pressure proves stronger than volume growth
- if market share in GLP-1 is lost
- if growth or margin forecasts disappoint given the premium valuation

> *"Vill man ha läkemedel, då är det det som gäller. Man vill ha ett stort läkemedelsbolag."*

---

### 🟠 SOBI — Sobi | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Beats high expectations repeatedly; eight analyst buys and no sells; niche profile may shield it from sector patent cliff.

#### Reasoning

A host highlights about 80% positive surprises since mid-2023, four in a row in the past year, and analyst support of eight buys, no sells. Sobi's profile may avoid the sector's 2027-32 patent expiry wave, and scarcity of pharma winners may bring a premium. The host stresses that its own patent portfolio must be checked and that the run of beats will eventually turn.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Sobi's own patent portfolio shows meaningful expiries
- if the run of positive report surprises ends

> *"Det är åtta köp, sen är det ett gäng avvakter men det är ingen som säljer Sobi."*

---

### 🟠 ORNBV — Orion | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Positive estimate revisions all year and over 80% positive surprises since mid-2023; up nearly 25% in October; analyst views mixed.

#### Reasoning

A host presents Orion as a pharma outperformer whose diversified, smaller profile may avoid the sector's patent expiry issue. Mixed recommendations, including sells, are seen as favourable because not everyone is already bullish. After a nearly 25% rise in October and with the hosts warning the trend will eventually turn, this is a watch rather than a recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if positive estimate revisions reverse
- if reports stop beating expectations

> *"Jag tyckte det var lite kul med de här två bolagen som faktiskt slår högt ställda förväntningar om och om igen."*

---
